title: TACTA Lemon Nicotine Strips 1mg - 20pk
description: Tacta Nicotine Strips Lemon utilise advanced dissolvable technology to deliver a seamless nicotine experience without smoke, vapour, or tobacco. These ultra-slim strips are placed directly on the gum, where they rapidly dissolve to provide a fast and effective 1mg nicotine delivery. The Lemon flavour profile is expertly balanced to be light and crisp, offering a pleasant citrus note that is fruity without being overly sweet. This makes it a refreshing choice for users seeking a clean palate alongside their nicotine fix. Designed for total convenience and hygiene, each of the 20 strips is individually wrapped. The product leaves no residue or waste, making it the ultimate solution for strictly controlled environments where discretion is required. How to Use: Nicotine Strips Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow these strips – they’re only designed to be placed behind your top lip.
